info.name: Find all employee consumptions for a specific company

params.name: companyId
params.description: The unique identifier of the company

params.name: payrollCycleId
params.description: The unique identifier of the payroll cycle. If not provided, the open payroll cycle will be used.

params.name: format
params.description:
The format of the resulting consumptions.
 - `lines`: as many lines as grouping benefits for each employee
 - `columns`: one line for each employee and as many columns as grouping benefits

params.name: categories
params.description: List of benefit categories to include in the response, which will return them in the same order as requested.

params.name: groupBy
params.description:
Consumptions can be grouped to return data that is more similar to how your system works. The consumptions can be grouped by:
 - `category`: it will calculate the sum of expenses minus withdrawals for all the consumptions in a category,
 - `category,behaviour`: sum of all expenses minus withdrawals for all the consumptions in category and behaviour.

items.docs: Find all employee consumptions for a specific company
